events.name: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears

headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams throws 2 TD passes as the Bears beat Drake Maye and the Patriots 30-24
headlines.description: — Round 2 went to Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears.

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers throws TD pass in Paris as Steelers beat Saints 16-10 in NFL's regular-season France debut
headlines.description: — Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers knew a protective slide was out of the question when he scrambled on a key fourth-quarter play in New Orleans territory Sunday.

headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Penix Jr. throws 3 TD passes, Falcons force 4 turnovers to give 49ers first loss, 29-20
headlines.description: — San Francisco's perfect start to the season was wiped out by a painful reminder that even an unbeaten team can't overcome a 4-0 deficit in turnovers.

headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson leads another game-winning drive as the Browns beat the Titans 27-24
headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson keeps turning in game-winning drives, and his career revival is keeping the Cleveland Browns atop the AFC North.

headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings defense clamps down on Daniel Jones and the Colts for a 16-10 victory to stay undefeated
headlines.description: — Blake Cashman led an onslaught of pressure all afternoon. Harrison Smith had the game-sealing interception.

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.shortLinkText: Malik Willis sparks first win for Jeff Hafley and Dolphins hold off late Jets rally in 28-25 victory
headlines.description: — Jeff Hafley had a towel draped around his neck as he stepped to the podium and the Miami Dolphins coach wiped his face one last time before taking questions from reporters.

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.shortLinkText: Bucky Irving runs for 2 TDs and Bucs force 4 turnovers in 43-13 rout of Panthers
headlines.description: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers wanted to make sure not to put too much on Baker Mayfield's plate with their quarterback still healing from a dislocated thumb and wearing a protective glove on his throwing hand.

headlines.shortLinkText: Burrow throws 4 TD passes as Bengals storm past Jackson-less Ravens in 2nd half of 35-13 win
headlines.description: — For 30 minutes, it was hard to tell which team was playing its backup quarterback, Cincinnati or Baltimore.

events.name: New York Giants at Houston Texans

headlines.shortLinkText: Singletary's 30-yard run in OT gives Giants 27-21 win over Texans
headlines.description: — Two weeks ago, Cam Skattebo's fumble in overtime cost the New York Giants a chance at a win.

headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Nix runs for a 62-yard TD, leads Broncos past the Cardinals for a 30-16 win
headlines.description: — Bo Nix has insisted throughout the past few months that the right ankle he injured during last season's playoffs is now healthy, even...

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.shortLinkText: Lions beat Packers 20-17 on last-play field goal to bail out Dan Campbell's failed 4th-down gamble
headlines.description: — Dan Campbell's latest gamble did not pan out and the Detroit Lions made plays in all three phases — with some yellow flags that went their way — to bail out the aggressive coach.

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Stafford sets Rams TD pass record as Los Angeles rolls past Raiders 35-21
headlines.description: — This was, especially in the first half, the kind of Rams team many expected to see all along.

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.shortLinkText: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 150 receiving yards and a score in the Seahawks' 20-3 win over the Chiefs
headlines.description: — Frustrated by a two-game skid, the Seattle Seahawks went into playoff mode.
